name: Panic Plastics, Inc.
old_description: Panic Plastics, Inc. Your Own Thermoforming Division At The End Of Your Phone!
about:
Panic Plastics, Inc. is based in Payette, Idaho, where it has operated for over 35 years. The company was founded to provide thermoformed plastic packaging solutions, though the exact founding year and ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs, develops, and manufactures custom thermoformed plastic packaging, including clamshells, blister packs, and thermoformed trays. It also offers stock packaging programs that eliminate mold costs and allow next-day shipping with minimum orders as low as a single case. In addition to packaging, Panic Plastics supplies printed insert cards, blister and clamshell sealing equipment, and provides in-house design and tooling services.

Its customers span a wide and diverse range of industries, though specific sectors are not listed. The company emphasizes working closely with clients from design through delivery to meet demanding schedules.

Panic Plastics states its mission is to manufacture the finest quality thermoformed packaging while delivering competitively priced products on time. Its stated values include respect for co-workers, ethical conduct, continuous improvement, and treating customers right. The company positions itself as a dedicated thermoforming division accessible by phone, highlighting fast-track delivery as a key service.
